## Checklist
- [ ] I edited files in `sources/`, not `fonts/` (build outputs are never hand-edited)
- [ ] `scripts/qa.sh` passes locally
- [ ] Rendered proof attached at 12px, 16px, 24px, and 72px
- [ ] Tested in at least one real paragraph of running text, not just isolated glyph view
- [ ] If this is a glyph redraw: matches the spec in `docs/design/` (linked below), or a spec-change issue is linked
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
